welcome.hero_title: Take control of your money with clarity
welcome.hero_subtitle: Savo helps you track expenses, plan budgets, reach savings goals and stay safe-to-spend — in your language, your currency.
welcome.features_title: Everything you need, nothing you don't
welcome.f_wallet_desc: Track cash, bank, savings, cards and wallets with live balances.
welcome.f_goals_desc: Set targets with deadlines and see exactly how much to save each month.
welcome.f_recurring_desc: Automate rent, subscriptions and salary with smart month-end forecasting.
welcome.f_analytics_desc: Understand your spending with clear charts, budgets and safe-to-spend.
welcome.f_budget_desc: Plan monthly budgets and always know how much you can safely spend.
welcome.f_alerts_desc: Get helpful alerts for upcoming bills, budgets and unusual spending.
welcome.f_security_desc: Two-factor authentication and full control over your data.
welcome.f_local_desc: Full support for English, French and Arabic with real RTL layouts.
welcome.meta_description: Track expenses, plan budgets, reach savings goals and stay safe-to-spend with Savo. Private, local-first personal finance in your language and currency.
welcome.value_title: Everything you need, nothing you don't
welcome.value_desc: Powerful financial management in a clean, private interface built for real life.
welcome.ai_title: Ask your money questions in plain language
welcome.ai_desc: Savo's assistant helps you understand your finances and act on them with confidence.
welcome.ai_point_1: Ask questions about your spending and budgets
welcome.ai_point_2: Get clear, practical guidance on your money
welcome.ai_point_3: Keep your conversations private and local
welcome.ai_chat_q: How much can I safely spend this month?
welcome.ai_chat_a: After your bills and savings, you still have room to spend comfortably this month.
welcome.sec_desc: Your data belongs to you. Savo is designed to be private by default, with the controls and options to fit how you manage your money.
welcome.cta_title: Take control of your money today
welcome.cta_desc: Create a free account and start making smarter financial decisions in minutes.
